name: essalud-ticket-system
description: Piloto académico e institucional de soporte — Red Asistencial Pasco

scripts.api:up: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.api.yaml up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 120 api
scripts.tickets:up: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.api.yaml -f compose.tickets.yaml up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 120 api
scripts.tickets:down: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.api.yaml -f compose.tickets.yaml down
scripts.demo:config: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.api.yaml -f compose.tickets.yaml -f compose.demo.yaml config --quiet
scripts.demo:up: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.api.yaml -f compose.tickets.yaml -f compose.demo.yaml up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 180
scripts.demo:status: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.api.yaml -f compose.tickets.yaml -f compose.demo.yaml ps
scripts.demo:logs: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.api.yaml -f compose.tickets.yaml -f compose.demo.yaml logs --tail 150 api web
scripts.demo:down: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.api.yaml -f compose.tickets.yaml -f compose.demo.yaml down
